htn_kidney.title: Drugs to Slow Progression of Chronic Kidney Disease: It's a Whole New World!
htn_kidney.authors: Schoonmaker JA, Bhasin-Chhabra B, Abow Alkhier A
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于综述研究。核心观点：肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统 (RAAS) 阻滞剂仍然是基础药物，现在由钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白 2 抑制剂 (SGLT2i)、非甾体类药物进行补充... 临床提示：慢性肾病 (CKD) 影响着美国约 14% 的成年人和全球约 10% 的成年人，并且仍然是一个主要的公共卫生问题。
htn_kidney.abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) affects approximately 14% of adults in the United States and about 10% worldwide and remains a major public health concern. Diabetes and hypertension are the leading causes of CKD and contribute to progressive nephron loss through disturbances in glomerular hemodynamics and filtration barrier, tubular and vascular function, and pathways of inflammation and fibrosis. Over the past two decades, an expanding set of therapeutic interventions has been developed that target key mechanisms of CKD progression. Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) blockers remain foundational and are now complemented by sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), non-steroi...

portal_hypertension.title: Portosystemic shunt creation in hepatic malignancies: Evaluation of risk for pulmonary metastasis development and progression.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hegde K, Iqbal S, Zoppo C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：鉴于 TIPS/DIPS 后血管破裂和新的门脉直接流出至心脏，应考虑术后肺转移的风险。 临床提示：如果患者出现难治性或危及生命的症状，可以考虑进行经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）或直接肝内门静脉分流术（DIPS）。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension is a prognostically unfavorable complication in settings of hepatic malignancy. A transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS), or a direct intrahepatic portocaval shunt (DIPS), may be considered if a patient develops refractory or life-threatening symptoms. Given blood vessel disruption and new portal outflow directly to the heart after TIPS/DIPS, the risk of post-procedure pulmonary metastasis should be considered. This study evaluates the safety and efficacy of portosystemic shunt creation in patients with hepatic malignancy and the incidence of pulmonary metastases. In this retrospective study, data were collected on patients with hepatic malignancy who underw...

portal_hypertension.title: Pre-TIPS Liver and Spleen Volumetry Are Not Associated With Liver-Related Outcomes After TIPS Placement for Refractory Ascites.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Bedoya JU, Wagner M, Malézieux E
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝脏容量测定可以预测肝手术前的结果，但有关其在 TIPS 放置前的作用的数据很少。 临床提示：我们的目的是评估肝脏和脾脏体积测量是否与腹水患者放置 TIPS 后的预后相关。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) improves survival in refractory ascites. A careful patient's selection is mandatory as TIPS can lead to complications. Liver volumetry is predictive of outcomes before hepatic surgery, but data on its role before TIPS placement are scarce. We aimed to evaluate whether liver and spleen volume measurements are associated with prognosis after TIPS placement in patients with ascites. We analysed data from three French centers, treated with TIPS between 2017 and February 2022. Inclusion criteria encompassed a TIPS placement for refractory or recurrent ascites and availability of cross-sectional imaging. Exclusion criteria included non-cirrhotic...

portal_hypertension.title: Reframing portal vein thrombosis in cirrhosis: A metabolic-endothelial disease beyond Virchow's triad.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：重新定义肝硬化门静脉血栓形成：一种超出 Virchow 三联征的代谢内皮疾病。

portal_hypertension.title: Hepatic venous pressure gradient, non-invasive tests, and prognosis across the subtypes of advanced steatotic liver disease.
portal_hypertension.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
portal_hypertension.authors: Hofer BS, Shalaby S, Kwanten W
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 696）。核心观点：脂肪性肝病（SLD）包括代谢功能障碍相关性肝病（MASLD）、酒精相关性肝病（ALD）和混合型肝病（MetALD）。 临床提示：我们研究了不同 SLD 亚型代偿性晚期慢性肝病 (cACLD) 的病程、具有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH) 的影响以及无创检测 (NIT) 的作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Steatotic liver disease (SLD) encompasses metabolic dysfunction-associated liver disease (MASLD), alcohol-related liver disease (ALD), and a mixed type (MetALD). We investigated the course of compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD) across SLD subtypes, the impact of clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH), and the role of non-invasive tests (NITs). This study included SLD patients with cACLD from 17 centers undergoing hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) and NIT assessment through December 2023. portal_hypertension.title: Evolution of liver disease severity and portal hypertension during REP 2139-Mg treatment in 3 patients with chronic hepatitis D : Case reports.
portal_hypertension.authors: Jachs M, Schwarz M, Mandorfer M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：REP 2139-Mg 的使用是一种新颖的治疗选择，最近在 2 期试验和同情访问计划中证明了有效性和安全性，该计划包括在维也纳总医院接受补偿的晚期慢性肝病的三名患者 临床提示：对于对布列韦肽±聚乙二醇化干扰素推荐治疗没有反应的患者，慢性丁型肝炎 (CHD) 的治疗选择有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Treatment options for chronic hepatitis D (CHD) are limited in patients who do not respond to recommended treatment with bulevirtide ± pegylated interferon. The use of REP 2139-Mg is a novel treatment option that has recently demonstrated efficacy and safety in phase 2 trials and a compassionate access program that included three patients treated at the Vienna General Hospital with compensated advanced chronic liver disease and clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH). Long-term outcome of CSPH patients treated with REP 2139-Mg is unknown; thus, surrogate endpoints are of interest in this population.
